name: hover-glare-card
title: Hover Glare Card
description: A card surface simulating iridescent holographic film that sweeps a bright specular glare band across the tilt angle.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Luxury
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Medium
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Grotesk
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Specular Glare Sweep: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
